## [1.4.2](https://github.com/FoxxoOwO/foxxo-patches/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2) (2026-10-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **aiplantdoctor:** drop the AI Plant Doctor patch ([cee17c1](https://github.com/FoxxoOwO/foxxo-patches/commit/cee17c126edf1f04b6fd440bf7787e037020f2c3))

patches.name: Chat only
patches.description: Turns Instagram into a chat-only messenger: opens Direct instead of the feed and removes the home feed, Reels, Explore, Stories, ads and suggestions. Long-press the Direct title (or the Profile tab) to open the Feurstagram settings.

patches.name: Clone
patches.description: Renames the package and app label so the patched build installs alongside a stock Instagram instead of replacing it.

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
A new app name (label). Entering "Instagram" skips changing the label.

patches.name: Debug bridge
patches.description: Development only: exposes the Feurstagram settings over ADB broadcasts so they can be driven from a shell instead of the on-screen panel.
